measurement_note: assigned_visible_cmap_count = code points in the font's cmap that are assigned in Unicode 17.0.0 and visible (General Category not Cc/Cf/Cs/Co/Cn/Zl/Zp, not Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, plus Prepended_Concatenation_Mark). Out of 159,375. A cmap entry is not proof of correct shaping, mark positioning, or style design.

policy.stack_rule: Device fonts first, embedded coverage fonts second; placeholder and detection fonts are applied per cell by detection and never appear in the global font-family list (PLAN.md D-6).
policy.egyptian: No Egyptian-hieroglyph font ships in standard or complete (PLAN.md D-4). Candidates are listed under candidates and are not fetched by default.
policy.delivery: Standard fonts embed in Unicode.html as data: URLs with unicode-range descriptors. Complete fonts ship as classic-script sidecar packs under unicode-fonts/ (one per pack, base64 data: URL registered via FontFace), loaded on demand per selected block and failing softly when absent (ADR-0001, PLAN D-10).
policy.style_packs: Style packs (D-14) carry the Unicode Font Kit's unicode-serif and unicode-sans stacks, restricted to OFL fonts: DejaVu (Bitstream Vera licence) and GNU FreeFont (GPL-3.0 with font exception) are excluded by licences_allowed; Noto CJK is excluded for size (device CJK fonts, Unifont and the Jigmo packs cover it). They load when the Serif or Sans button is chosen; the 'styled' packs load only when Bold or Italic is on.

fonts.note: Maps every code point to a glyph naming its block. Applied per cell by detection, never in the global stack (PLAN.md D-6). The 'HE' (high-efficiency) build was rejected on 2026-10-08: its cmap format 13 subtable is not usable as a web font in Chromium (measured: zero glyphs even for BMP characters), so the full build with a format 12 cmap ships instead (PLAN.md D-11).

pack_rule: A pack is attached to the blocks in its declared categories (data/block-categories.json) whose visible assigned code points its fonts map at least a quarter of; tools/fonts/buildPacks.ts computes and records 'blocks'. Coverage, not novelty: an installed outline pack is preferred over the embedded bitmap fonts wherever it applies, and the category scope keeps stray ASCII glyphs from attaching a CJK pack to Basic Latin. The app loads a pack only when one of its blocks is selected (ADR-0001).
